scope: New read-only SAP diagnostic of all 34 restored first-Rust groups. No search, threshold change, frozen-vetting replay, FPP integration or physical denial.
method: Original exact first-proposal P/epoch/duration; SAP quality zero, finite positive errors; divide each quarter by its positive flux median. For each quarter with >=5 in-window and >=10 local-baseline cadences, depth = median flux at |phase| in [D,min(2D,.45P)] minus median at |phase|<=D/2. Average quarter depths; standard error is sample SD across quarters/sqrt(Nquarters). This uncalibrated diagnostic S/N measures quarter consistency, not original detector S/N or native-fit significance. No detrending or sibling masking. Shoulder depths and opposite-phase depths diagnose morphology, without assigning a false-positive mechanism.
limitations: Not a replacement for the calibrated survey or accepted posterior clock.
Broad periodic modulation can produce high diagnostic S/N.
Period/epoch aliases, per-event independence, exposure integration, correlated noise, transit transfer, host identity and localization require scientific review.
Original search S/N remains null where unavailable.
